steps.say: To round, find the digit in the place you are rounding to. Then look at the digit on its right.
The ten thousands digit is 8, which is 5 or more, so round up.
Decimals round the same way. To round 6.348 to two decimal places, look at the thousandths digit.

figure.alt: A number line from 6.34 to 6.35 in thousandths with 6.348 marked.

steps.say: Rounding helps you estimate. Round each number, then do the easier calculation.
Use the estimate to check an exact answer. If the two are far apart, check your working.

hints: One decimal place means keeping the tenths.
check.explanation: 7.462 is between 7.4 and 7.5. The hundredths digit is 6, so it rounds up to 7.5.

options.why: That is the nearest whole number.
The hundredths digit is 6, so round up.

hints: Look at the hundred thousands digit.
check.explanation: 3,649,200 is between 3,000,000 and 4,000,000. The hundred thousands digit is 6, so it rounds up to 4,000,000.

check.prompt: Estimate 19.8 × 5.1 by rounding each number to the nearest whole number.
hints: Round each number to the nearest whole number.

options.why: That uses 19 instead of 20. 19.8 is closer to 20.
